description: This file provides utility functions for encrypting and decrypting string values using NaCl SecretBox encryption. It handles base64 encoding/decoding, retrieves encryption keys from environment variables or a master key, and includes error handling and logging for debugging encryption processes.

methods.name: _get_salt_key()
methods.description: Retrieves the salt key from environment variables or falls back to a master key imported from another module.

methods.name: encrypt_value_helper(value: str, new_encryption_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using a signing key, encoding the result with URL-safe base64.

methods.name: decrypt_value_helper( value: str, key: str, exception_type: Literal["debug", "error"] = "error", return_original_value: bool = False, )
methods.description: Decrypts a string value using the signing key, attempting URL-safe base64 decoding first, then fallback to standard base64.

methods.name: encrypt_value(value: str, signing_key: str)
methods.description: Encrypts a string using NaCl SecretBox with a SHA-256 hashed signing key, returning encrypted bytes.

methods.name: str decrypt_value(value: bytes, signing_key: str)
methods.description: Decrypts bytes using NaCl SecretBox with a SHA-256 hashed signing key and returns the plaintext string.

ctags.name: decrypt_value_helper
ctags.signature: ( value: str, key: str, exception_type: Literal["debug", "error"] = "error", return_original_value: bool = False, )
